pageDescription: Finds empty folders inside a folder, including folders that hold only other empty folders. System, program and project folders are never listed; nothing is removed without confirmation.
idleDescription: Only folders and the names of what they hold are read; no file is opened.
checkEmptyDetail: No files inside, not even in subfolders. The folder you choose is never listed.
checkProtectedDetail: System and program folders, drive roots, the main profile folders (Desktop, Documents, Downloads…), AppData, .git and node_modules.
checkSkipDetail: Hidden folders, links, unreadable folders and folders excluded here or in Settings: the folder that holds them does not count as empty.
scanCancelled: Search stopped: the results are partial.
moveAction_one: Move {{folders}} folder to the Recycle Bin
moveAction_other: Move {{folders}} folders to the Recycle Bin
confirmRecycleTitle_one: Move {{folders}} empty folder to the Recycle Bin?
confirmRecycleTitle_other: Move {{folders}} empty folders to the Recycle Bin?
confirmRecycleDesc: Before it is moved, each folder is checked again and left in place if it is no longer empty, is protected or is excluded. You can restore them from the Recycle Bin.
confirmPermanentDesc: Before it is deleted, each folder is checked again and left in place if it is no longer empty, is protected or is excluded. This cannot be undone: the folders do not go to the Recycle Bin.
deletingRecycle_one: Moving {{folders}} folder to the Recycle Bin
deletingRecycle_other: Moving {{folders}} folders to the Recycle Bin
deletingFacts: Each folder is checked again before it is touched.
receiptRecycleTitle: Folders moved to the Recycle Bin
receiptSkipped_one: {{skipped}} folder skipped because it is no longer empty, is protected, is excluded or could not be accessed.
receiptSkipped_other: {{skipped}} folders skipped because they are no longer empty, are protected, are excluded or could not be accessed.
deleteRecycleToast_one: {{folders}} folder moved to the Recycle Bin
deleteRecycleToast_other: {{folders}} folders moved to the Recycle Bin
